rootCause: The old 60+ channel Discord structure was still present and was not fully hidden from no-role members. The bot onboarding/database system existed, but Discord channel permissions allowed members to join without going through the intended /apply approval pipeline.
actionsTaken: Enforced the lean approval gate across start-here, introductions, daily-signal, questions, build-lab, review-queue, content-lab, live-room, resources, wins-showcase, premium, and team-ops.
Archived 74 legacy channels/categories by denying @everyone view access. No channels were deleted.
Reset 6 human non-owner members to no Sage-controlled roles.
Cleared generated Discord member/application/onboarding proof rows so no existing human member remains approved without manual review.
Posted an onboarding reset notice in start-here telling members to run /apply and wait for manual approval.
remainingManualDiscordSetting: For Discord's native pending-member approval UI like Nexural, enable Membership Screening/Rules Screening in Discord Server Settings. The bot-side approval gate is now enforced by roles and channel permissions.
